scope: Exploratory A/C U6G test, paired on two completed training seeds
seed_deviation: User elected two seeds after plan freeze; C seed 44 was stopped. Three-seed decision rule does not apply.
sampling: Paired A/C source random streams keyed by seed, test group, scene, array, frequency, angle and draw
evaluation_grid: native radio map 128x128 after bilinear align_corners=False downsample
primary: Per-image MAE in dB; average draws and angles equally within scene then scenes equally
secondary: Per-image RMSE and PSNR (range 300 dB), and SSIM on raw dB with population covariance, Gaussian 11x11 sigma 1.5 and fully valid windows
boundary_implementation: At 128x128, a cell is building-occupied when any of its four 256x256 height pixels is >0; dilate occupied by Chebyshev radius 3, exclude occupied, intersect label support.
bootstrap: Two-sided scene-paired percentile bootstrap, 10000 draws, fixed seed 20261101; first average paired scene differences across the two training seeds. Does not capture full training-seed uncertainty.
